hypothesis: Broad auxiliary ENTRY supervision can improve robustness without widening the decoded head; same-capacity sharp auxiliary control isolates target width.
protocol: Initial one-fold seed0 feasibility screen on known-duplicate-grouped splits; no selection/promotion from this single fold. Extend to five folds and three seeds only if resource budget and first-screen behavior justify it.
training: CPU only; sequential; nice15; one thread; RAM backpressure; no extra pseudo labels or GPU use
primary_gate: No candidate adoption from one fold. Confirm on grouped five-fold matched seeds; target robust source/rate gains with <=0.005 native regression. Broad vs sharp control required.
